offense.name: Low Pass
offense.effect: Ball moves 1 space forward or backward. Ball speed increases 1.

offense.name: Dribble Advance
offense.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Manipulate ball speed up to player’s offensive skill.

offense.name: High Pass
offense.effect: Ball moves forward 2 spaces. If ball reaches goal, set up a scoring opportunity.

defense.name: Block Deflect
defense.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If reaches offense’s goal, sets up scoring opportunity. Ball speed decreases by 1.

defense.name: Steal Intercept
defense.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Manipulate ball speed up to defensive skill.

defense.name: Pressure
defense.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If reaches offense's goal, triggers own goal.
